title: Babai's problem
exact_target: Which finite groups always preserve their sets of character sums of each character degree when two of their Cayley graphs are isomorphic?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7400001 (AMR-073-0001). CC BY 4.0.
Alireza Abdollahi and Maysam Zallaghi, Non-Abelian Finite Groups Whose Character Sums Are Invariant but Are Not Cayley Isomorphism (2017), v1; arXiv:1710.04446.
